narr: An upper level shortwave trough brought a cold front through South Central Texas. Thunderstorms developed along this boundary and some produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding.
ev: Thunderstorms produced heavy rain that led to flash flooding. Culverts filled with water and washed road edges on CR 532 east of Moulton.
lsr: EM REPORTS SCATTERED FLASH FLOODING IMPACTS TO ROADWAYS MAINLY EAST OF MOULTON INCLUDING CR 532. FULL CULVERTS LED TO SOME MINOR WASHOUTS AT THE ROADS EDGES BUT ROADWAYS ARE STILL PASSABLE. TIME APPR
